title: 第11章 白首之约

content_zh:
她问：“什么东西这么难，想了几个月？”
王亨就告诉她：这些数字是按一定的规则排列的，现在打乱了，只要他寻找出规律，将数字复原，合上了里面的机关暗锁，就能林馨儿恍然大悟：这有点像她前世玩的数字魔方，或者九宫格数字推理运用在机关暗锁上。
她疑惑地问：“你解过吗？”
王亨道：“解过。我常玩。”
又有些不好意思道：“原本我不喜欢这门亲事。父亲和母亲就说，只要我能解开这个盒子，亲事就作罢。我一直没解开，所以……”所以才不得不娶她！
林馨儿道：“那你今晚要解开了呢？”
难道要把她给退回去？
当然，那样也挺好。
聘礼就不用退回了。
王亨道：“里面的东西就送你。”
林馨儿为他的不坚定叹气。
王亨不再同她废话，就对着盒子苦思起来，时而拨转一下数字；而林馨儿则满屋子乱转，置身于一座宝库中的感觉并不好，这些东西不拿出去，始终是死物、废物，若她偷一两件出去，只怕也没那个福气享受。
所以，她挺没劲的。
最后，她还是在王亨身边坐下，看他做数字推理。原本她不想看，是怕自己忍不住提醒他，会露了马脚；结果她认真看了一会，发现人家玩的级别根本不是她能操作的。
她震惊不已——
这孩子的聪明，简直逆天！
她越来越觉得，他像个谜。
原以为会煎熬，然一夜很快过去了，不知王亨是被新婚大喜刺激了还是怎的，大约凌晨时分，他终于那一刻，林馨儿也激动万分。
“快看看，是什么！”
静夜中，她本能压低声音。

王亨小心掀开盒盖，里面不是一览无余的，而是又分为三层小抽屉。他拉开第一层抽屉，取出一块极品血玉，下面附有一张图纸。那是一对交颈鸳鸯，有机关可以拆开，交合部分就在颈部。若胡乱拆解，容易将鸳鸯脖子掰断了。
王亨照着图纸，反复试了几下，才欣喜地将玉鸳鸯递给林馨儿，道：“今晚是我们的洞房花烛夜，这对鸳鸯送给你。你可收好了。我们要像他们一样白头偕老的！”
林馨儿猝不及防之下，愣住了。
明明是孩子气的玩笑话。
为什么这话让她想落泪？
不是因为这极品玉鸳鸯珍贵，而是他努力了几个月，又在洞房花烛夜研究了整整一晚，才表白！
别说他还是孩子，这话不能当真。
就因为是孩子，不掺杂任何杂念，才纯真。
林馨儿下意识地就接过鸳鸯，胡乱问道：“都给我一个人？不是我们一人一只吗？”
王亨很内行道：“我们在一起，当然鸳鸯也要在一起。要是我们分开了，就一人留一只。——当然不能分开！”
林馨儿看着男孩，不知说什么才好。
青梅竹马？
两小无猜？
好像都挨不上。
王亨又去开第二层，又取出一只玉鱼莲坠，长身小头无鳞。鱼身弯成弧状，昂首，尾上翘，有六片鱼鳍，都刻有细阴线。鱼身旁伴一荷叶，长梗弯曲，盘而成环，可以穿绳。
“这也给你。戴着玩。”他道。
又拿出一个金玉海东青啄雁，他自己要了；剩下的珍珠宝石等，反而没让他看上眼；最后一层是一本古籍，他翻了翻，欢喜极了，塞进怀里，然后连盒子都交给林馨儿。
“走！我们去做第三件事。”
他兴奋地拉起林馨儿。
还有第三件事？

林馨儿不禁嘻开嘴，期待起来。
两人将紫檀宝盒送回新房，这次是大摇大摆回去的，惊得丫鬟们大眼瞪小眼，她们还正等小主子起床呢。
王亨不理她们，让林馨儿把盒子放下，对她道：“新妇嫁过来，要洗手作羹汤。我们去厨房做饭去。祖母和母亲教养我很辛苦，不知费了多少精神。我之前还为亲事跟母亲发了脾气呢，惹她难过，很是不该。现在，我们为她们做早饭，一是孝顺长辈；二是感谢母亲为我娶了你。”
林馨儿摸着他脸笑道：“真是好孩子！”
她一下子忘了自己的身份，调戏起人家来。
王亨却很开心，冷不丁地又在她脸上亲了一下。
林馨儿气得也亲了回去。
两人打闹成一团，笑声飘出新房。
厨房内，王亨将下人都赶了出去，只留下大厨师为他们烧火，他和林馨儿亲自动手做早饭。揉面、切菜……一番忙碌下来，两人头脸都沾满了白粉，跟花脸似的。

content_en:
She asked: "What is so difficult? You have been thinking about it for several months?"
Wang Heng told her: These numbers were arranged according to certain rules, but now they were disrupted. As long as he found the rules, restored the numbers, and closed the secret lock inside, Lin Xiner suddenly realized: This is a bit like the number Rubik's Cube she played in her previous life, or the use of nine-square numerical reasoning on the secret lock.
She asked doubtfully: "Have you ever solved it?"
Wang Heng said: "I solved it. I often play."
He was a little embarrassed and said: "Originally I didn't like this marriage. My father and mother said that as long as I could untie the box, the marriage would be abandoned. I never untied it, so..." That's why I had to marry her!
Lin Xiner said: "So are you going to untie it tonight?"
Should we send her back?
Of course, that's fine too.
There is no need to return the bride price.
Wang Heng said: "I will give you the contents inside."
Lin Xiner sighed at his lack of determination.
Wang Heng stopped talking nonsense with her and began to think hard about the box, occasionally turning the numbers; while Lin Xiner wandered around the room. It didn't feel good to be in a treasure house. If these things were not taken out, they would always be dead and waste. If she stole one or two pieces out, she might not be able to enjoy the blessings.
So, she's pretty boring.
Finally, she sat down next to Wang Heng and watched him do numerical reasoning. Originally, she didn't want to look at it because she was afraid that if she couldn't help but remind him, she would be exposed. But after looking at it carefully for a while, she found that the level he was playing was not something she could operate at all.
She was shocked——
This kid's intelligence is incredible!
She felt more and more like a mystery to him.
I thought it would be a torment, but the night passed quickly. I wonder if Wang Heng was stimulated by the wedding or something. Around early in the morning, when he finally arrived, Lin Xiner was also extremely excited.
"Look, what is it!"
In the quiet night, she instinctively lowered her voice.
Wang Heng carefully opened the lid of the box. The inside was not unobstructed, but was divided into three layers of small drawers. He opened the first drawer and took out a piece of top-grade blood jade with a drawing attached underneath. They were a pair of crossed-necked mandarin ducks. There was a mechanism that could be taken apart, and the joining part was at the neck. If you dismantle it randomly, it is easy to break the mandarin duck's neck.
Wang Heng followed the drawings and tried several times before he happily handed the jade mandarin ducks to Lin Xiner and said, "Tonight is our bridal chamber night, and I give these pairs of mandarin ducks to you. You should keep them. We want to grow old together like them!"
Lin Xiner was caught off guard and froze.
It's obviously a childish joke.
Why did these words make her want to cry?
It's not because this top-quality jade mandarin duck is precious, but because he worked hard for several months and studied it all night in the wedding room before confessing his love!
Don't say he is still a child, this cannot be taken seriously.
Just because they are children, without any distracting thoughts, they are pure.
Lin Xiner subconsciously took the mandarin duck and asked casually: "Give it to me alone? Shouldn't there be one for each of us?"
Wang Heng said expertly: "When we are together, of course the mandarin ducks must also be together. If we separate, let each of us keep one. - Of course we cannot separate!"
Lin Xiner looked at the boy and didn't know what to say.
Childhood sweetheart?
Childhood sweetheart?
It seems like they can't stand it.
Wang Heng went to the second floor and took out a jade fish lotus pendant with a long body and a small head without scales. The body of the fish is curved in an arc, its head is raised, its tail is upturned, and it has six fins, all of which are engraved with thin negative lines. There is a lotus leaf beside the fish. The long stem is curved and coiled into a ring for threading a rope.
"This is for you too. Wear it for fun." He said.
He also took out a piece of gold, jade, sea and green pecking goose, and he wanted it for himself; the remaining pearls and gems did not attract his attention; the last layer was an ancient book, he flipped through it, and he was so happy that he stuffed it into his arms, and then handed the box to Lin Xiner.
"Let's go! Let's do the third thing."
He excitedly pulled Lin Xiner up.
There is a third thing?
Lin Xiner couldn't help but smile and look forward to it.
The two of them took the red sandalwood box back to their new house, this time in a swaggering manner, which shocked the maids, who were still waiting for their young master to get up.
Wang Heng ignored them and asked Lin Xiner to put down the box, and said to her: "When the bride gets married, she has to wash her hands to make soup. Let's go to the kitchen to cook. My grandmother and mother raised me very hard, and I don't know how much energy they spent on me. I lost my temper with my mother before about the marriage, and it was wrong to make her sad. Now, we make breakfast for them, firstly, to be filial to our elders, and secondly, to thank my mother for marrying you for me."
Lin Xiner touched his face and smiled: "What a good boy!"
She suddenly forgot her identity and started teasing others.
Wang Heng was very happy and kissed her on the face again without warning.
Lin Xiner was so angry that she kissed him back.
The two quarreled and laughed out of the new house.
In the kitchen, Wang Heng drove all the servants out, leaving only the chef to light the fire for them. He and Lin Xiner made breakfast themselves. Kneading dough, chopping vegetables... After all the busy work, both of their heads and faces were covered with white powder, as if they had painted faces.
